# A choice between two attribute maps on an element that is patched in place
# writes one map's attributes and removes the other's, so toggling the choice
# leaves only the attributes the current map names.
# A name the element takes as a prop of its own is that prop's, and no branch
# removes it.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'
grep 'data-n="1"' app.sngl.snapshots/narrow.html
grep 'class="keep"' app.sngl.snapshots/narrow.html
! grep 'data-w=' app.sngl.snapshots/narrow.html
grep 'data-w="1"' app.sngl.snapshots/wide.html
! grep 'data-n=' app.sngl.snapshots/wide.html
grep 'data-n="1"' app.sngl.snapshots/narrow_again.html
! grep 'data-w=' app.sngl.snapshots/narrow_again.html

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import html "sngl:platform/html"
import test "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component box ui.node {
    var wide = false
    var show = true

    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #flip(text="flip", @click { wide = !wide })
        if show {
            html.div(attrs=wide ? {"data-w"="1"} : {"data-n"="1"}) {}
            html.div(class="keep", attrs=wide ? {"class"="hot"} : {"data-c"="1"}) {}
        }
    }
}

func testFlip(t test.Test, c box) {
    t.snapshot("narrow")
    c.flip.click()
    t.snapshot("wide")
    c.flip.click()
    t.snapshot("narrow_again")
}
-- testrun/html/none/app.sngl/box/1 --

      "Desc": "Flip",
      "Passed": true
    }

    "narrow_again.html": "",
    "wide.html": ""
  }
}
